verdicts.originalText: Undone Be Thy Sinful Hex (A4) is not modelled. Oz's ~1s attack cadence typically steals Electro reactions before the active character can make them, and the passive doesn't proc when Oz himself causes it — making it unreliable in most off-field Fischl team comps.
verdicts.proposedText: Not modeled: the extra Electro DMG when the active character triggers an Electro reaction while Oz is on the field. Oz's ~1s cadence usually reacts first, and it doesn't fire on Oz's own reactions.
verdicts.rationale: Rewrite, not implementDelete: no effect is authored for this passive, and its real limitation (which unit caused the reaction / aura-and-timing simulation) is on the CANNOT list, so 'Not modeled' is honest. Compressed to fix style violations — stripped the character name ("Fischl"), the ability name ("Undone Be Thy Sinful Hex (A4)", both shown by the panel chip + title), and the banned "modelled" spelling. Folded in the passive's payload (extra Electro DMG on active-character Electro reactions) from the description field, kept both mechanical reasons it rarely lands, and used the stock "Not modeled:" opener. "Oz" retained as an allowed kit proper noun.

claimsLost.claim: making it unreliable in most off-field Fischl team comps

demotedNotes: Dropped the concluding note that the A4 passive is unreliable in most off-field Fischl comps; this conclusion follows from the two kept reasons (Oz steals the reaction / doesn't proc on Oz's own reactions) and is already recorded in the existing curator note.
